links.outcome: Decision reliability of guideline-grounded agentic framework versus LLM-based and task-specific baselines across six epilepsy tasks
links.effect: Guideline-grounded generative coordination combined with discriminative evidence gave more reliable and comprehensive decisions than conventional LLM-based and task-specific baselines; no numbers in abstract.
links.quote: Results demonstrate that integrating discriminative evidence with guideline-grounded generative coordination yields more reliable and comprehensive decisions compared to conventional LLM-based and task-specific baselines.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent orchestration combining modality-specific discriminative model outputs with generative agents for multimodal clinical decision support

screen.reason: The paper evaluates an agentic framework incorporating clinical guideline grounding and multimodal evidence integration compared to baseline LLM models across six clinical epilepsy management tasks.

primary.practice: clinical guideline grounding in agentic workflow
